**Test Case ID:** TC-SEOS-04
**Title:** Heading count on Popular Buses [en] still matches the snapshot
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Confirm Popular Buses (en) still has the same number of SEO headings as the snapshot.

**Expected Result:**
Popular Buses (en) still has 15 SEO headings.

**Steps:**
1. Open Popular Buses (en)
2. Count SEO headings
3. Compare with the snapshot count
